mapper.select: select address_id, member_id, label, full_address, phone, is_default, create_time, update_time from mall_address where member_id = #{memberId} order by is_default desc, create_time desc
mapper.insert: insert into mall_address(member_id, label, full_address, phone, is_default, create_time) values(#{memberId}, #{label}, #{fullAddress}, #{phone}, #{isDefault}, #{createTime})
mapper.update: update mall_address set is_default = '0' where member_id = #{memberId}
